title: Frankfurt
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text. State 2 side A is the same back.
sideBSummary: Frankfurt, blue, 50°6'39"N 8°40'56"E. Compass with no anchor. One covered SEARCH box. The name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. P4-07b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: As a free action, while this card is in your hand, take Supply cubes from an adjacent location and place them into your location. The card does not say to discard it.

states.summary: SEARCH reveals Companion Messenger. As a free action, you may take Supply cubes from an adjacent location and place them into your location if this card is in your hand. P4-07b stays on the scratched face. Side A is still the Player deck back.

rules: Blue Player card for Frankfurt. Not a port. The compass has no anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face.
Companion Messenger: a free action, while this card is in your hand, moves Supply cubes from an adjacent location into your location. The printed word is location, not city.
notes: Card id 10805. Scratch state card id 10713.
No improvement bullseye is printed. The scratch box covers the center.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
